fomod.Name: NPC Pathing NG
fomod.Author: GennyWoo
fomod.Description: NPC traversal and navmesh failsafe for Skyrim SE/AE. Stuck NPCs hurdle, vault and drop on their own, or climb with SkyParkour and EVG Animated Traversal markers when those are installed. Detects Fluid Motion and NpcTraversalNG (Enemies Can Jump and Vault) and lets them go first. One installer, no choices: everything is detected.
